intro: An ancient standing mirror blocks the path. Your reflections in it are... not quite doing what you're doing.
title: The Mirror of Truth
description: The mirror shows every Pokémon as it truly is — its stat spread reversed. To claim that truth, you must defeat your own reflections. Win, and you choose who gazes in. Lose, and the mirror chooses for you.

1.label: Face Your Reflections
1.tooltip:
(+) Win: flip ONE chosen Pokémon's stat spread
(-) Lose: the mirror flips SEVERAL at random
1.selected: The glass ripples. Your reflections step out of the frame.

2.label: Avert Your Eyes
2.selected: You edge past the mirror, eyes on the ground. Something in the glass sighs.

outroFailed: The glass drinks the light. When your vision clears, some of your Pokémon look... rearranged. The mirror hums, satisfied.
outro: The mirror stands silent now, showing only ordinary reflections. Mostly.
